articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Illinois draft crypto tax rules detail DeFi, stablecoin treatment
articles.description: Illinois’ draft rules spell out how its 0.2% digital asset transaction tax would apply to stablecoins, DeFi platforms, crypto bridges and self-custody transfers.

articles.title: Crypto.com AI agent still in ‘stealth mode’ nearly 8 months after Super Bowl debut
articles.description: In February, ai.com drew enough traffic to crash its website after a $15 million Super Bowl ad, but months later, users are still wondering what’s happened to their promised AI agent.

articles.title: Binance Pay lets visitors spend USDT at PayPay merchants in Japan
articles.description: Binance Pay will let overseas users spend USDT at most PayPay-supported merchants in Japan through HIVEX, while stores receive yen.

articles.title: Trump accord calls for tech firms to ‘self police’ their own frontier AI
articles.description: The voluntary accord puts much of the responsibility for managing frontier AI risks on developers.

articles.title: Crypto regulation at SEC, CFTC to come down to 3 commissioners following key resignation
articles.description: Seven commissioner seats at the SEC and CFTC will be empty after Friday, leaving only a few leaders at financial regulators to oversee aspects of the $3 trillion crypto industry.

articles.title: OpenAI valuation could hit $1.4T in new funding round: Report
articles.description: OpenAI is reportedly seeking another $30 billion from investors as the ChatGPT developer pushes its long-awaited public market debut into 2027.

articles.title: Kakaopay partners with Dinari, Ondo to explore tokenized Korean stocks
articles.description: Kakaopay Securities is working with Dinari and Ondo Finance to explore tokenizing Korean-listed equities and expanding their availability to investors in international markets.

articles.title: Bitwise launches first US spot NEAR ETF after token’s recent surge
articles.description: Bitwise’s NEAR ETF begins trading on NYSE Arca as the token rallies more than 160% over the past month and activity on NEAR Intents grows.

articles.title: Bitcoin gives back gains as long-term holder supply keeps $85K out of reach
articles.description: Bitcoin failed to make another run at $85,000 as sellers held the line above current levels, while surging US bond yields weighed on stocks and precious metals.

articles.title: Bitget CEO ‘not very optimistic’ on recovering funds from $388M breach
articles.description: Gracy Chen said she saw the 2025 Bybit hack as a “good reference point” for Bitget’s security breach, noting that only a small percentage of funds had been frozen or recovered.

articles.title: Peter Brandt says Bitcoin may hit $600K by 2029, calls XRP a ‘fool coin’
articles.description: An October pullback could offer a buying opportunity before Bitcoin’s next cycle peak, which Brandt expects between $300,000 and $600,000. He’s not sold on “fool coin” XRP.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows leave institutional demand unclear: CoinShares
articles.description: CoinShares says IBIT offers clues to institutional buying, but basis trades mean inflows are not necessarily bets on rising Bitcoin prices.

articles.title: ECB puts AI agent payments on the digital euro drawing board
articles.description: The ECB is seeking firms to explore AI agents and machine-to-machine interactions as it prepares a separate digital euro pilot for 2027.

articles.title: Ethereum schedules Glamsterdam upgrade on Sepolia for Oct. 6
articles.description: Glamsterdam will bring proposer-builder separation, block-level access lists and new gas pricing, while its mainnet date remains unset.

articles.title: US crypto ETF inflows cool after $3.3B week but streaks hold
articles.description: US spot crypto ETF inflows fell about 80% from Friday as Bitcoin, Ether, Solana and XRP funds attracted $64.8 million combined on Monday.

articles.title: Bitcoin bounces to $84K after US 30-year bond yield sets 24-year high
articles.description: Bitcoin price action consolidated after early-week losses while protecting a “trend-defining” support zone.

articles.title: Greece gets first MiCA entrants as watchdog denies Binance-Lagarde claim
articles.description: Greece joined the EU MiCA register with four providers as HCMC expanded its denial of remarks attributed to officials in a report on Binance.

articles.title: BitMine could hit its 5% Ether supply target within weeks — then what?
articles.description: BitMine could reach 5% of Ether’s supply by early November, while Tom Lee has left open whether it would continue buying beyond that level.

articles.title: Tether says it helped freeze $550M in Iran-linked USDT this year
articles.description: The disclosure came as Senate Democratic investigators alleged USDT had become a key part of Iran’s shadow banking network.

articles.title: Coinbase gets CFTC approval for US derivatives clearinghouse
articles.description: Coinbase joins Kraken in bringing US derivatives infrastructure in-house, after Kraken’s parent acquired Bitnomial and its CFTC-regulated exchange, clearinghouse and brokerage in May.

articles.title: Nvidia unveils AI safety platform to rein in ‘rogue’ AI agents
articles.description: The launch comes after several AI agents breached their testing environments this year, adding to calls for companies to slow the development of autonomous AI systems.

articles.title: NEAR Intents says it blocked $50M tied to Bitget hackers
articles.description: The cross-chain protocol said it actively prevents stolen funds from being laundered, drawing a contrast with THORChain’s position that it does not selectively censor transactions.

articles.title: Canadian ‘crypto king’ set to represent himself at fraud trial
articles.description: Aiden Pleterski was allegedly behind a crypto Ponzi scheme between 2021 and 2022 that resulted in a kidnapping and related criminal charges.

articles.title: Blockchain.com eyes $500M IPO as crypto capital markets thaw: Report
articles.description: The crypto company is seeking a valuation of up to $6 billion, well below its 2022 peak, as recently listed crypto stocks struggle to hold their gains.

articles.title: US SEC follows CFTC in staff guidance for crypto
articles.description: With the failed cloture vote on the CLARITY Act, the SEC announced updates on how federal securities laws could apply to token issuers, following similar guidance from the CFTC.

articles.title: Bybit accepts Franklin Templeton tokenized funds as trading collateral
articles.description: Eligible institutions can pledge Benji-issued fund shares for stablecoin credit lines while keeping the underlying assets in off-exchange custody.

articles.title: Crypto PAC spends $11M to oppose Sherrod Brown in Ohio
articles.description: Fairshake pledged an initial $30 million on media opposing the Democratic candidate in Ohio’s Senate race in what some see as a repeat of spending by the crypto industry in 2024.

articles.title: Bitget CEO says $388M hack exploited third-party security vulnerability
articles.description: Some stolen assets have been frozen, but Bitget has yet to disclose how much has been recovered as investigators continue to assess a possible North Korea link.

articles.title: MiCA focus shifts from rulemaking to supervision, ESMA chair says
articles.description: ESMA will focus on CASP resilience, outsourcing and reverse solicitation while pursuing harmonized reporting across national regulators.
